svg.title: Raspberry Pi 5 header map
svg.desc: Every pin of the Raspberry Pi 40-pin header, with the pins this build uses highlighted and labelled.
svg.text: Pin 1 is the corner nearest the USB-C power socket. Hold the board with the header on the right and pin 1 at the top.
The dial's + goes to pin 1 (3.3 V), never to 5 V —
its pull-ups would put 5 V onto a GPIO and damage the Pi.
Any GND pin works electrically; these keep the runs short.
Solder the 5 V split on pin 4 rather than stacking Dupont ends.
